title: Need Free AI Game Assets? Now you can generate Sprites and Tilesets for your Indie game in seconds
author: NoPromotion2534
selftext:
Let’s be honest: spending half a day on a single sprite that still looks shitty... that's the worst!

You deserve to spend your time on the fun part: coding. That’s why I created Spritefy. Consider it an early Christmas gift from me to you! :D

You can use it to generate all your game assets in seconds and keep your workflow moving.

Here is what you can create with it:

* Characters & Animations: Sprites in different positions and animation frames.
* World Building: Seamless tile sets and backgrounds that match your style.
* Items
* Effects

There is a free plan available, so you can jump right in and start creating without any catch.

It’s still in the early stages, so I’d love to hear your honest feedback. What’s missing? What should I add next?

Try it out here: [https://spritefy.com](https://spritefy.com/)

Enjoy and Merry Christmas! 🎄

comments.author: AreaCoinMan
comments.body: Good idea! I would remove the fake "see what others saying" section from the website. its insincerity is off putting.

replies.author: AreaCoinMan
replies.body: np, I joined your community too. GL

comments.author: RealAstropulse
comments.body: New flavor of the week sprite generator that doesn't actually understand pixel art. Thought the sub was over that phase.

replies.author: monsterfurby
replies.body:
Yeah. Pixel art is inherently kind of incompatible with the way this kind of image generation works. I think it would need something much closer to an LLM but with color/saturation values per pixel instead of text tokens (kind of like music generation works).   
Plus, static images are cheap - if there's ever one that makes a proper, coherent sprite sheet or animations, that might be interesting.

replies.author: RealAstropulse
replies.body: I mean its all available over at retro diffusion. Sprites, animations, even tilesets and editing, all pixel consistent with limited colors and a size you can set yourself.

replies.body: For visibility the poster makes retro diffusion.

replies.body: Aye, said that in another comment in the thread. Sorry I kinda just assume people know me at this point.

replies.body: Fair enough, and you even did say below but in case that was all this person read wanted him to understand for context.

replies.body:
Can you explain that? Would love to improve the tool so it can really delivers the most value.

You mean the possibility to generate/animate Pixel Art in the correct dimensions? Like 16x16 32x32px?

comments.author: JustANerd420
comments.body: Cool idea, but I am among others that are tired of seeing applications all have monthly fees to them. I don't think people understand that we already pay out the butt once a month to streaming services, gaming services, ai services, etc. Would be actually nice if we have programs that are pay once (Not hundreds of dollars either) and you have access to it.

replies.author: RealAstropulse
replies.body: The running costs for ai apps are so high this just isnt possible. It would go bankrupt in hours with just a handful of active users.

replies.author: NoPromotion2534
replies.body: Thank you!  With Spritefy you have the option though to subscribe to a free plan which grants you free monthly generations. And if you go over the credits limit you can buy credits as well. So you are not  necessarily bound to a monthly fee. I totally get your point, but unlimited free generations is just not feasible for such an application.
